newsitems.title: Coming Soon: Knockout Expansion
newsitems.author: OriginalCopy
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/OAr7WlfFDx4"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]Coming Soon: Knockout Expansion[/h1][p]Ever wanted to punch that glyphid who messed up your perfect dive?[/p][p]Ever wondered what it would be like to crush an alien with your bare hands?[/p][p][/p][p]Well with the Knockout expansion, you won’t have to wonder, and you can get your revenge!

[/p][h2]NEW CLASS: BRAWLER[/h2][p]Management has ordered a more Hands-on approach in the shape of the new Brawler class[/p][p]An up close and personal melee focused class, ready to brawl, maul and haul with lots of new close range weaponry![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726543/929cd3e5264aee296adc3eacd7d76d9999a795e0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]NEW BIOME: SANDBLASTED CORRIDORS[/h2][p]Dry and inhospitable, but rich in resources[/p][p]Dwarves never shy away from a challenge when there are riches to be had, so we know you’ll go there, even through Sand Twisters and an environment out to kill you[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726543/e1fb47f51e074342d1b05b036b5f63abbd503759.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]NEW MISSION: BROOD HARVEST[/h2][p]Management requires more samples of Kytoplasm, a new resource with lots of potential to R&D.[/p][p]Management has a keen interest in these samples and will support any endeavor, but the indigenous creatures are also very protective of their brood so be careful down there miner! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]The Knockout Expansion is a paid DLC coming to DRG: Survivor soon, alongside a free update to the base game [/p][p]We will reveal more details in the weeks leading up to the Expansion release![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5269530/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Survivor__Knockout_Expansion/"]Wishlist now![/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]If you happen to have other devices handy though, you can play DRG: Survivor on Playstation 5 and Nintendo Switch at soon as next week*[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/rsfKZS-rgo4"][/dynamiclink]*some regions may be delayed due to platform rollout[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Bingo. Giveaways. DRG: Survivor announcements. It’s all coming to the BIG BREAK
newsitems.author: GSG Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726543/cd0b68d5271c2fcdebbcba373bd90113234a1f81.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Hello Miners,[/h1][p]
The BIG BREAK SHOWCASE is almost here. It’s going live on [b]Tuesday, September 29th at 19:00 CEST/10am PDT[/b] — and we’ll be there to make a couple of exciting announcements about Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor.[/p][p] [/p][previewyoutube="S86vIZTUi_k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oIJOpx40nfs"]Click here to head to the Big Break premiere on YouTube.[/url][/h3][p]
Of course, we’ll be joined by dozens of other delightful developers sharing and showing off their own games — AND, if you tune in, you’ll have the chance to win free games! There will be live prize giveaways of Coffee Stain titles during the premiere.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726543/5494aa91b61e1f6b3ccff51434e324e600cdc3e8.jpg"][/img]And don’t forget your Official Big Break Bingo Sheet! Share it in your local Discord and follow along together. There is no real prize. Unless you count the priceless memories you’ll make while watching the showcase.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726543/bd134ad38339e943110c8fd6f142e6b0478219cd.jpg"][/img]Hope to see you there!

[i]Yabba dabba doo,
-Funday Games
[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: We’ve got beans to spill at The Big Break
newsitems.author: GSG Aaron
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726543/1b8f20600829682b3cbf538dfbd9cc6e09afac90.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Miners,[/h1]

We’ve got fun news for you. But we can’t share it yet.

This is an announcement of an announcement to say that the Big News is coming on September 29th as part of Coffee Stain Publishing’s Big Break Showcase.

[previewyoutube=7zI1MdfuQ7c;full][/previewyoutube]
Expect thrills. Chills. Goats. Dwarves. Computer games. The Big Break will premiere live on [url=https://www.youtube.com/CoffeeStainStudios]Coffee Stain’s YouTube page[/url] on [b]Tuesday, September 29th at 19:00 CEST / 1:00 PM EDT.[/b] If you can’t catch the premiere, a full video will of course be available after. But then you won’t be able to tell your grandkids that you saw The Big Break live. Your call.

Announcement of announcement concluded. As you were. Hope to see you on the 29th.

[i]Hugs and kisses,
-Funday Games
[/i]

newsitems.title: 1.1 Patch 1
newsitems.author: OriginalCopy
newsitems.contents:
[h1]Improvements & Fixes[/h1][list][*][p] Updated to Unity version 6000.4.7f1  - fixing a memory leak[/p][/*][*][p] Adjusted some texture resolutions for memory preservation[/p][/*][*][p] Improved the way assets are stored in memory for considerable gains[/p][/*][*][p] Drone based Sidearm overclocks are now part of the 3 sidearm mission goal[/p][/*][*][p] Addressed an issue with glyphids standing still[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue with Warden teleporting, see yeeting, across the map[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where unlocks would show a mix of thunderhead auto cannon and Lok-1 Smart rifle[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where audio files not playing could cause a crash between stages[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where sectors could be unlocked without clearing the gate [/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue with Kaisong Scissor Ray beams overlapping[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Kaisong Scissor Ray would unlock status effect damage upgrade cards, without having a relevant tag[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where some overclocks could be picked multiple times[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where proximity mines would explode extremely loudly when entering the drop pod[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where Voltaic Field generator wouldn't show all stats[/p][/*][*][p] Tweaked Egg Hunt Collect Gold biome goal, making it easier to achieve[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where the demolisher classes turn radius was out of sync, they now all have the same, improved, turn radius[/p][/*][*][p] Brood sprouts will now properly deal damage to players[/p][/*][*][p] Improved scroll speed in UI views[/p][/*][*][p] Improved the ordering of milestones
[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: DRG:S Voice Line Competition!
newsitems.author: Stidsholt
newsitems.contents: [h1]Hello Miners,[/h1][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch of the Heavy Duty Expansion, we're giving away a Steam Deck and a bunch of keys for the game and the DLC. But instead of just making a giant sweepstakes, we thought we'd make it a bit more interesting.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Submit a suggestion for a dwarf Voice Line![/b][/h2][p]Do you scream along when the dwarves go [i]"YOU WANT SOME MORE?"[/i] Have you always dreamt of having your own voice line in the game? Submit an awesome voice line and you just might get your dream fulfilled. If we find some very good voice lines, they might be featured in the game, but no guarantees! The winner of the competition will be chosen randomly from a pool of entries reviewed by Funday Games. Terms & Conditions apply, see the bottom of the Gleam.io page.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]1 submission will receive a Steam Deck![/p][/*][*][p]10 submissions will receive Steam keys to Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor and the new Heavy Duty Expansion DLC.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Enter Here: [url="https://gleam.io/JIqv9/drgs-voiceline-competition"]https://gleam.io/JIqv9/drgs-voiceline-competition[/url][/b][/p]

newsitems.title: 1.1 Hotfix 2
newsitems.author: Stidsholt
newsitems.contents: [h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Demolisher could get stuck on detonators, supply pods, cargo pods and the like[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed audio bugs on Rock Dozer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some weapon audio would continue through pausing and shops[/p][/*][*][p]Improved video settings tab[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display and resolution application bug on startup[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Q'ronar not taking damage from player projectiles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a specific Cryo effect could scale up more than intended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a specific Warden effect could scale up more[/p][/*][*][p]Carrier Drone now displays all sub-drone damage types when inspected in pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect icon in certain demolisher milestones[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Path of Mastery display bug[/p][/*][*][p]Detonator collider removed as soon as the detonator is activated - fixing an issue that would get Demolisher stuck on them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could get DLC notifications without the DLC[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with players could die in between mining red sugar and recieving the health benefits[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance changes[/h2][list][*][p]Demolisher controls are tighter in both standard and simplified mode[/p][/*][*][p]E1M1 Caustic Scattergun buffed: Base damage 18 → 20, Potency 18 → 20[/p][/*][*][p]Chimera Fragcannon buffed: Target highest HP[/p][/*][*][p]Carrier Drone buffed: Potency 6 → 7[/p][/*][*][p]Springloaded Ripper buffed: Fire rate 1/sec → 0,67/sec, is not also a projectile weapon, allowing for more synergies[/p][/*][*][p]Toxic Sludge Spreader buffed: Base damage 10 → 12, status effect damage 6 → 7[/p][/*][*][p]Slither Drones buffed: Base damage 60 → 75[/p][/*][*][p]Kaisong Scissor Ray mastery bonus set to damage[/p][/*][*][p]AKIMBO tag upgrade added: Bigger Cogs[/p][/*][/list]
